thread:
Priya (Docs): Hey team, opened a small PR to align export examples across the Ruby SDK and CLI and to tighten SOC2/GDPR wording: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4299 :wave:
Ibrahim (Security): Thanks. Two asks: 1) use the single term 'pseudonymize' everywhere (avoid 'anonymize'/'de-identify') and 2) always show TTL units in examples (e.g., 30d) so it's unambiguous.
Carmen (Legal): Agree. For EU-facing copy add '(GDPR art.4)' after pseudonymization and avoid words like 'permanently' or 'irreversible' unless we can back that with retention proof. Add a short footnote: 'Pseudonymization reduces identifiability; it may not equal irreversible deletion.'
Priya (Docs): Will update. Dropping current examples for quick review. JSON primary example:
{
  "event_type": "data.access",
  "timestamp": "2025-09-12T10:12:00Z",
  "tenant_id": "tenant-ac02",
  "subject": "user_777",
  "pseudonymized_fields": ["email", "ip_address"],
  "retention": "30d",
  "pseudonymize": true
}
Priya (Docs): Edge-case when tenant unknown: 
{
  "event_type": "data.access",
  "tenant_id": null,
  "redacted_fields": ["email"],
  "retention": "90d",
  "pseudonymize": false
}
Tess (SDK): Ruby snippet: make sure we show symbol-style keyword arg so it matches user expectations. Example: 
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
client.exports.create(tenant: 'tenant-ac02', scope: 'audit_logs', retention_days: 30, pseudonymize: true)
CLI-Bot: Added `--pseudonymize` alias to staging; help text updated to: `--pseudonymize    pseudonymize sensitive fields in export (boolean)`
Ibrahim (Security): Also document whether mapping keys are reversible and where they are stored (KMS/HSM). Suggest a parenthetical in examples like '(mapping stored: yes|no)'.
Carmen (Legal): Approved wording with the footnote and the mapping clarification. For public docs we should say: 'If a reversible mapping is kept, treat the export as pseudonymized (not anonymized).'
LinkCheckerBot: Found one broken anchor in the PR -> docs/reference/exports.md#cli-usage (404). Suggested target: /docs/reference/exports/cli.md or add redirect.
Priya (Docs): I'll fix the link, standardize terms to 'pseudonymize', add TTL samples 30d/90d, include tenant-null example, add legal footnote, and note mapping stored: yes/no. Will update PR and ping when ready.
Ibrahim (Security): 44d I'll do a 5-min pass after updates, focusing on mapping and retention wording.
Tess (SDK): Sending a tiny SDK PR to ensure param name matches exactly.
Priya (Docs): Targeting to merge today after the tiny SDK/CLI fixes. Thanks all :sparkles:
